# AstryxCheckboxList { #anylumino.AstryxCheckboxList }

```python
AstryxCheckboxList(items, value=(), *, label, **props)
```

Render a multi-choice Astryx checkbox list.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------|-----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Any\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | _required_ |
| value   | Iterable\[str\] | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `()`       |
| label   | str             | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | _required_ |
| **props | Any             | JSON-safe CheckboxList props. Useful keys: isLabelHidden, description, density, hasDividers, isDisabled, status, className, and style. anylumino generates checkbox items from items and manages value/onChange synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/CheckboxList>. | `{}`       |
